underlying_goal: Fix a bug where summary and reference_file fields in knowledge_lookup responses were empty despite data existing in the index, then verify the fix works end-to-end through the MCP bridge
friction_detail: The MCP bridge repeatedly timed out due to stale/zombie bridge processes, preventing end-to-end verification through the bridge despite the fix working via direct WebSocket.
brief_summary: User asked Claude to investigate and fix empty summary/reference_file fields in knowledge_lookup responses; the bug was correctly diagnosed and fixed with all tests passing, but MCP bridge verification was blocked by stale bridge processes requiring a session restart.
